build_transformer_model: build a TransformerModel with specified ntoken, ninp, num_heads, hidden_dim, and num_layers parameters
build_transformer_lstm_model: build a TransformerLSTMModel combining a transformer encoder with an LSTM decoder for sequence modeling
run_transformer_forward: run the TransformerModel forward pass with source and target tensors for training or inference
run_transformer_lstm_forward: run the TransformerLSTMModel forward pass with source and target tensors using teacher forcing
review_positional_encoding: review the PositionalEncoding class that adds sinusoidal positional encodings to input embeddings
